targeted IRQ checkpoint/history after exact template repair

observations.read_only_ds_write: QEMU enters #GP before the dword store through read-only DS, preserves the authored backing and fault frame, then retries once after the handler reloads writable DS. Frozen DOSBox-X reaches completion with DS=0x20, no handler marker and the dword stored. This is a reference divergence, not a paired parity pass.
observations.checkpoint_fixture: The earlier fixture wrote through CS after setting CR0.PE. The new QEMU rights check rejected that protected-mode code-segment write. The fixture now writes the same PSP scratch location through its writable DS; the six mode/checkpoint cases passed in the focused seven-case run.
observations.regression_scope: The selected 30-case run yielded 29 passes and one fixture-template mismatch; the changed IRQ generator passed its targeted rerun on the same binary. These are separate runs, not one clean 30-case batch.
